title: Auditing a KB Elicitation of Frontier LLM Knowledge: A Multi-dimensional Analysis of GPTKB v1.5
abstract: arXiv:2510.07024v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLMs are remarkable artifacts that have revolutionized a range of knowledge-intensive tasks. A significant contributor is their factual knowledge, which, to date, remains poorly understood, and is usually analyzed from biased samples. In this paper, we provide a framework and the results of a multi-dimensional analysis of GPTKB v1.5 (Hu et al., 2025a), a recursively elicited Knowledge Base (KB) of 100 million facts (or beliefs) of a frontier LLM, namely, GPT-4.1. Given the scale of the elicited facts, we provide a multi-dimensional approach to qualitatively and quantitatively analyze these facts as opposed to the mainstream fact completion benchmarks, which are prone to availability bias. translated_title: 审计前沿大语言模型知识的知识库引导：GPTKB v1.5的多维度分析
translated_abstract: 大语言模型是了不起的产物，已经革新了一系列知识密集型任务。其重要贡献因素之一是它们的事实性知识，然而迄今为止，这些知识仍然鲜为人知，且通常仅从有偏差的样本中进行分析。在本文中，我们提供了一个框架以及针对GPTKB v1.5（Hu等人，2025a）的多维度分析结果。GPTKB v1.5是一个通过递归方式引导构建的知识库（KB），包含来自前沿大语言模型GPT-4.1的一亿条事实（或信念）。鉴于所引导事实的庞大规模，我们提供了一种多维度方法来对这些事实进行定性和定量分析，以区别于容易受可得性偏差影响的主流事实补全基准测试。我们发现，模型的事实性知识与既有知识库存在相当显著的差异，其准确度也显著低于以往基准测试所显示的水平。我们还发现，不一致性、歧义和幻觉现象……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文对从GPT-4.1递归引导构建的包含一亿条事实的知识库GPTKB v1.5进行了多维度审计分析，发现大语言模型的事实性知识与既有知识库差异显著，且其准确度远低于以往基准测试所显示的水平。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a multi-dimensional audit of GPTKB v1.5, a recursively elicited knowledge base of 100 million facts from GPT-4.1, revealing that LLM factual knowledge differs significantly from established knowledge bases and its accuracy is substantially lower than indicated by previous benchmarks.
